_readme: Crew supplies: food, water and air for the crew on the ship. They are a separate group from the six resources, and show only in Flight and Arrival. per_person_per_day = how much ONE person uses in ONE day (real NASA numbers, with the quote and link in each source). The game multiplies it by crew_size and by the game days that pass. Every fact is written as { "value": ..., "source": ... }. A source is a NASA link or the word PLACEHOLDER (made up for now; a student replaces it before the final submission). start_amount = what the ship carries at the start. capacity = the most a meter can hold (the bar's full size). A meter turns yellow below warning_percent of its capacity and red below danger_percent. Tasks: rationing slows how fast food drops, and swapping the scrubber puts air back (a better timed press puts back more). The water leak is in events.json. The words on the screen are in data/story.json and data/inner_voice.json.

food.source: Lopez, Schultz et al., Logistics Needs for Potential Deep Space Mission Scenarios Post Asteroid Redirect Crewed Mission, NASA Johnson Space Center, Table Food/Crew Provisions: 'Food Kg/crew/day 1.831 BVAD Table & ISS experience' (includes packaging). https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20150003005/downloads/20150003005.pdf

water.source: NASA-STD-3001 Technical Brief OCHMO-TB-027 Water: 'Potable Water for Hydration Minimum 2.5 L (84.5 fl oz) per crewmember per day'. https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/ochmo-tb-027-water.pdf

air.source: Lopez, Schultz et al. (same paper), Table Gases: 'O 2 Metabolic kg per crew/day 0.82 HIDH / BVAD'. https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20150003005/downloads/20150003005.pdf
PLACEHOLDER (the air meter can go above its start amount, because a fresh scrubber adds air)

arrival_crew_days.source: PLACEHOLDER (how many days of crew supplies the 60 second Arrival walk stands for)

amount.source: PLACEHOLDER (percent of damage when a crew supply hits zero)

food_use_factor.source: PLACEHOLDER (with rationing on, the crew eats 0.6 of the normal food each day)

result_show_seconds.source: PLACEHOLDER (how long the ring stays on screen after the press)
